prompts.label: A｜静かな文庫
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE refined high-fidelity Japanese iPhone story-reader modal screenshot, portrait 9:19.5, front-on actual app screen, no phone hardware, no perspective, no presentation board, no collage. This is a DESIGN ALTERNATIVE for an existing pixel-art lofi focus app. Image 1 is a reference ONLY for the app's black-based visual language, champagne accent and quiet material treatment, NOT for its audio controls. Completely replace the audio screen with a story-reading modal. Image 2 is the ACTUAL CURRENT-RANK ARTWORK: a silver-haired young woman working at a rooftop desk, warm lamp, holographic screen, potted plants, railing, and darkness above. Use Image 2 faithfully for any illustration/background. NO buildings, billboards, roads, trains, distant neon skyline or other scenery from Image 1: those would spoil later ranks. Do not invent new art or characters.
The screen is a large almost full-height reading modal with soft rounded top corners, tiny drag handle, small close X at top right, unobtrusive iOS status and home indicator. Black-based aesthetic; soft ivory Japanese book typography; muted gray secondary information; sparse champagne accents. Strong typographic hierarchy, large comfortable touch targets, careful margins at least 28pt, good line spacing, realistic readable body size equivalent 16–17pt on a 390pt wide phone. Design for reading and atmosphere, no huge buttons, no thick dividers, no bulky segmented rectangles, no giant English headings, no extra invented features or marketing copy. Display exactly the same approved story and chapter across all proposals.
Exact story title: "夜にちょうどいい広告".
Current chapter position: "3/5".
Exact chapter title: "眺めていられる動き".
Exact body text, preserve paragraph breaks and use elegant Japanese typesetting:
考えがまとまらず、椅子にもたれる。

鉢植えの葉が、風に揺れていた。
派手な動きではないのに、つい目で追ってしまう。

彼女は画面に向き直り、図形が回る速さを落とした。
少し動いて、少し休む。それだけにしてみた。
At the bottom, tasteful chapter navigation: chapters 1 and 2 are available, chapter 3 selected, chapters 4 and 5 shown ONLY as tiny lock symbols (no future chapter names and no preview images). Include modest "前の話" and a lock with "続きはランク4で", no active Next button because rank 4 is locked. All of this chapter's text must fit on screen at readable size without clipping, no duplicated text. Render only the literal Japanese labels and text requested. DESIGN A — A QUIET DIGITAL NOVEL. Entire reading sheet has a refined near-black ink background with just a barely perceptible cool charcoal gradient, opaque and distraction-free. NO illustrations in this variant. At the top, put the story title small and muted next to a tiny book line icon; the close icon opposite. Leave measured breathing space, then small champagne "3/5", a fine short horizontal rule, and the chapter title in beautiful medium-sized Japanese Mincho serif type aligned left. Body below in a restrained Japanese serif, medium ivory rather than bright white, spacious paragraph breaks and optical margin. Use plenty of intentional negative space below the short text. Bottom chapter markers are five tiny understated circular stops connected with a hairline; selected third has a slender champagne ring, last two tiny locks. The content feels like a beautifully typeset page from a short novel. Minimal clean sophisticated typography, not generic settings UI.
